# Serenity Spa

> Serenity Spa is the day-spa and wellness club on the 4th floor of Hilton Tashkent City (Ukchi 1, 100027, Tashkent, Uzbekistan), open daily 07:00–23:00 to hotel guests and external city visitors by advance reservation.

Serenity Spa (also known as Serenity Spa Tashkent, Serenity Spa Hilton, спа Хилтон Ташкент) spans 1,200 m² and features a 27 m panoramic indoor pool (28°C), 38°C hydromassage jacuzzi, 95°C dry Finnish sauna, hammam-style steam bath, fitness studio, private massage suites and couples ritual rooms. All prices are settled in Uzbekistani som (UZS) via Visa, Mastercard, Uzcard or Humo.

Last updated: 2026-11-14
Location: Ukchi 1, Hilton Tashkent City, 4th floor, 100027, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
Entrance: Main entrance of Hilton Tashkent City
Phone: +998 71 210 88 95
WhatsApp: +998 94 940 10 35 (https://wa.me/998949401035)
Email: spa@hilton-tashkent.com
Hours: Pool, gym and saunas daily 07:00-23:00
Currency: UZS
Accepted cards: Visa, Mastercard, Uzcard, Humo
Parking: 100,000 UZS for 2 hours
Provided: Towels, bathrobes and slippers
Booking: Advance booking required for all guests (confirmation by administrator before arrival)
Hotel guests: Pool, gym, jacuzzi, Finnish and steam saunas are complimentary for guests staying at Hilton Tashkent City
Individual treatments: Pool and saunas are not included; standard day access is charged separately (600,000 UZS weekdays / 700,000 UZS weekends)
Gift certificates, foreign-card and online payments: Confirm current conditions directly with reception

## Service Pages (English)

- [Lymphatic Drainage Massage in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/lymphatic-drainage-massage-tashkent): Gentle 90-minute rhythmic detox drainage massage — 1,350,000 UZS
- [Couples Spa in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/couples-spa-tashkent): 4-hour Serenity Package for Two (5,000,000 UZS total for two guests) and 4.5-hour Signature for Two (5,500,000 UZS)
- [Spa Gift Certificate in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/gift-certificate-spa-tashkent): Gift options across massages and multi-hour spa packages; terms and denominations confirmed with reception
- [Body Wraps & Scrubs in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/body-wrap-tashkent): 60-minute Lavender, Chocolate, Avocado & Silk and Detox body wraps (850,000 UZS) plus exfoliating peels
- [Pool & Wellness Day Pass in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/pool-day-pass-tashkent): Single-entry wellness ticket (600,000 UZS weekdays / 700,000 UZS weekends) covering pool, gym, saunas and jacuzzi
- [Spa with 27 m Panoramic Indoor Pool](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/spa-with-pool-tashkent): Year-round 27 m indoor pool (28°C) and 38°C hydromassage jacuzzi on the 4th floor of Hilton Tashkent City
- [Finnish Sauna & Hammam-Style Steam Room](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/sauna-hammam-tashkent): 95°C dry wood-lined Finnish sauna, humid hammam-style steam bath and 850,000 UZS post-steam body peels
- [All-in-One Spa Packages in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/spa-packages-tashkent): 3 to 4.5-hour Men’s (1,800,000 UZS), Women’s (2,200,000 UZS), Signature (3,000,000 / 5,500,000 UZS) and Couples (5,000,000 UZS) programs
- [Pool, Gym & Spa Memberships in Tashkent](https://serenityspa.uz/en/services/wellness-membership-tashkent): 12-visit bundle (4,500,000 UZS), 1–12 month adult tiers (Standard, Bronze, Silver, Gold), annual Family plan and Kids cards
